markers.name: FM_OINO_DOWNSTAIRS
markers.note: Body enters the domestic table space; recording may be carried from holy-fool exit. Eyeline finds sister first.

markers.name: FM_SISTER_ANGRY
markers.note: Anger is personal and rhythmic — not a moral prop. Breath, jaw, table contact carry her own tempo.

markers.name: FM_OINO_SITS_BESIDE
markers.note: Beside, not opposite as judge. Weight settles into presence.

markers.name: FM_ACCEPTS_BOWL
markers.note: Hands receive nourishment; two bowls become shared meal. Gift toward care.

markers.name: FM_PRESENT_NO_FORGIVENESS_DEMAND
markers.action: Oino remains present without demanding immediate forgiveness
markers.note: No speech that extracts absolution. She stays. Sister's anger may continue — allowed.

markers.name: FM_SISTER_TAPS_OLD
markers.action: the sister taps the old melody
markers.note: Fingers on table / bowl rim — CALL_06 seed. Her rhythm, slightly off the archive grid.

markers.name: FM_OINO_ANSWERS
markers.note: Voice, tap, or hum answers her sister — dialogue of bodies, not archive control.

markers.name: FM_SISTER_CHANGES_NOTE
markers.note: Real creative contribution — new interval / timing. Not a symbolic child's accident.

markers.name: FM_OINO_ALMOST_CORRECTS
markers.note: Micro-reach toward the 'right' archive pitch — shadow reflex — then stops.

markers.name: FM_OINO_FOLLOWS
markers.note: Eyeline and breath join the sister's changed note. Memory becomes participation.

markers.name: FM_OPEN_DOORWAY
markers.action: final story image — the open doorway
markers.note: Composition holds the open doorway (answer to closed attic). Women may be in frame or just left; doorway reads as invitation kept open.
